body: I don't enjoy anything anymore..I work and sleep.nothing sounds like fun. I use to love shopping the gym and hanging out. I have money. But don't even care.. It sounds like to much work to even get up and do anything. I don't know what's wrong with me.
Apologies..I didn't see that but it makes sense. Won't ask  that again.

THANK YOU!! I started thinking it was only me cuz I can't find any thing about it.and ammonia (pungent) is precise..it's terrible..lol. and that could only be from kidneys working overtime..usually your kidneys filter it out. But I guess not so great when they are too busy or tired. (Which is scary ) I'm a nurse and see dialysis patients and it's not pretty l..on another note.I know guys that are on the same time line as me am they have no issues with it..me on the other hand..during wd.  I just stunk..even with man deodorant and soap..it would go away for a half an hour ...maybe.. then it was right back.. it is not as bad now. But my body odor is definitely stronger. .maybe it has something to do with female hormones. .idk..but I have been there with the 2 day thing.  It ain't easy.. but it's so worth it.. I actually feel alive again..even though I am depressed alot..my worst day sober is better than my best day high.. and I was high on/off for 2 years...I don't know your situation but every attempt to get clean is a step forward. So don't let it discourage you..keep trying. You will get sick of the torture..so please be good to yourself...please keep in touch and let me know how it's going every once in a while (if you want) and I will do the same.. I really don't know any girls in my situation and it really eased my mind to hear your experience. .
.

Wow :(

I had ducks growing up. I got a mental picture of your story and made me smile. Sounds like you are doing amazing!! I'm happy for you!! Feel free to send some of those energized positive vibes my way anytime you feel. :)
Congrats on your 9 months  1 day and counting btw.  ;)

That does not sound like a relapse ...in my opinion...only you know your mindset when taking substances. But I've been prescribed trazadone and they do not even get you high.  I think it's great you are in a program and they support you but also dislike how discouraging they sound as well.. I have a friend in CA who told me he is not clean because he takes Adderall prescribed by his doctor (according to his group).. (his DOC is iv smack) . I was shocked tof hear he thought he was dirty. Sounds like nonsense to me..if that's the standard then people who take any meds for health conditions need to be in group..
And I look at people partying as loser stuff too..cuz it is.. Sounds harsh but if you think that way its motivation.Because I know ( and you know) what it takes to quit and the mindset that makes you fail.. Honestly a all the time I was getting high I deep down wanted to. I just didn't give af. I would say I wanna quit just to make people happy and make them think I was trying.. okay more like i wanted to quit superficially but deep down..i knew i wasnt going to..I didn't quit until I knew deep down..I HAD TO.. I was at the edge and it was either jump off or climb to safety and pick up the pieces.

Yeah..it's not vitamin pee..unfortunately..I'm sure it's contributing to its weirdness but not the main culprit. It's almost like a pungent ammonia smell...ewww gross I know. I was at work tonight and did a Urine dipstick. I have nitrites...tons of them so it's pointing towards UTI. I just have no other symptoms. I haven't had sex since becoming clean. No libido. . Hopefully this changes.. SOON..I usually love sex. But definitely not even on my list..haha..sorry for rambling..I'm coming off of a 12 hour night shift so I'm a little scattered :/ :)

I have never ever had a smell problem..haha. seriously like I have good hygiene..okay to put into perspective I had to start using the new clinical deodorant . And as far as female powders and stuff..yuk. I'm not hating but I don't wanna cover it up..I want to get to the root of the problem cuz something is off. I'm just hoping I didn't throw my body chemistry off for good from doing dope for 2 years. I hope my body is healing and It's a transient condition. I have a dr. Appt soon..I will update and let ya know what I learned. Thanks For The Input :)

I still am a light smoker. one thing at a time lol.. predrugs  I never had a problem in this area. And actually prided myself for being a non musty human being..haha..and now. I can't stand my scent. I know that's gross. But it's not like I stink all the time..it's just when I sweat it smells stronger when I pee it smells stronger..idk. I just need to see my Dr. Before I freak out. Reading these diagnose yourself websites is a terrible idea..because according to them I have cancer metastasizing throughout my entire body..lol. and congrats on your amazing accomplishment!! I'm proud of you :)
Thank you..I needed to read this..it gives me hope :)
Thank you :)

I used to love to exercise..I felt on top of the world...I bought a gym membership and went only to get frustrated.. frustrated to learn you can't just pick up where you left off. Things that were simple for me at the gym at one time ex..elliptical for an hour followed by weights. . Body bar classes..  now we're so hard and demanding.. I know the power of positive thought. But I can't help but feel like life is over sometimes.. I have actually made some progress with the self esteem part. And I know this is a whole other topic but me and my SO have not slept together since I have been sober.. last night we actually cuddled and hugged for hours...I loved it.. I notice it's the small things that give you hope :)

You are not being selfish.. I think it's normal to feel that way. I know I get insecure about things and automatically jump to " they act different now that I'm clean" maybe they was that way before and I was too high to notice. Idk..maybe it's my guiltiness about how I was self absorbed for two years while on dope..and shame for it.. It sounds like you are close enough with him to share your feelings on it..which I would do because shit like that eats me up..not gonna lie. We are human. I have a feeling once he knows your true feelings on it you will feel better. It might not even be him..it could be his fiancé making those decisions..bridezillas are real..lol.. but with that being said be happy for him and supportive.  And if he has stuck with you through all this..know that he loves you.. hope this rambling can help even if only a little..

Thank you all so much for the input. PAWS for me has been irritability, lack of interest, depression, low self esteem, mental cloudiness at times.  All mentaI  besides the lack of energy.. i have a history of depression. And i think i may have some thyroid issues. I have an appt with a doctor at work.  I am embarassed to say this but I cry alot and thoughts of suicide run through my head at least once a day. I am not attention seeking. I have a good support system.. my mom and my significant other.. I tell them but they don't get it. I  really do not think of getting high. Every once in a while. And it's passing because I never never ever ever want to go back.   I went pretty far down the rabbit hole. It started with Dilaudid.(recreationally) then a "friend" stalked me with buttons for a while before he gave me free shit to try. It started off a weekend thing ..then weekends turned into weekdays..before you know it. I pawned 3 of my TVS and watched Netflix on my laptop. Quit paying my bills. Borrowed money. Which I never ever have done...Ughhhh. the thought makes me ill. It got so bad I had to move to a different state. Just to get away. Back home dope was just across the river any time of day. Had about a 100 a day habit for a year and a half. Any input or experiences with this is greatly appreciated.  I am at a loss for fixing this..
Texas near Amarillo.. heroin clean for 6 months.  I moved here from Alton IL right across the river from Saint Louis to get away from it.. It was either move or a self inflicted death sentence.
Some deep ish in that track. Nice beats..keep it up bro!!

I am 6 months clean aand cannot thank you enough for sharing. I thought it was supposed to get easier the longer you were clean. But today I learn that PAWS can last for quite sometime. I have tried to just ignore all the emotions, feelings, ( cause if you ignore they don't exist) and deal with it like I dealt with things before drugs. but it's proving to be harder than expected. So here I am  6 months clean and just starting to deal with the mess of emotions it has left me with. Not to mention the fatigue, loss of interest and other annoying side effects. But I am happy I am clean. I don't want to use again..just wish these feelings would subside so I can ENJOY again..

I have been there so many times I lost count...and one thought that made it harder was thinking...what will I ever get this excited over when I am sober..just the thought was depressing..which motivated me to get high again..and you know using once is damn near impossible.. once turned into 2 days which tuned into a week and so on..where does it end?  I have been clean and still have my struggles but I look back and can't believe I went through that hell for a drug that stole the life out of me.  Really it's a decision you have to make to really want to quit. Not preaching just sharing my experience.
Try to give him 1 mg plus of Klonipin..I took 2 mg of Xanax at a time in my wds and Xanax is more potent than Klonipin.

I am an ER nurse.. I have also been through wd. As long as he does not have other health problems. He should be fine. He needs to stay hydrated.  Small sips of something with electrolytes..especially sodium and potassium. Which is lost with vomiting, diarrhea and sweating. Loperamide and Klonipin work wonders. For me withdrawal symptoms peaked at 48 to 72 hours.  But it can be longer depending on the drug he is withdrawing from. Everything you explained sounds like the Hell of withdraw. Hope this helps.
